# Introduction

This post documents, end to end, how the raw World Cup Matches dataset is cleaned before it's used in the [World Cup hosting premium analysis](../world-cup-hosting-premium/index.qmd). Keeping the cleaning steps in their own post makes them traceable and reproducible independent of any downstream analysis, and the resulting cleaned dataset is what gets published to Kaggle.

```{python}
import pandas as pd
from great_tables import GT, md, html
```

# Data sources

## World cup hosts

The host nations for each of the World cups is extracted from [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_FIFA_World_Cup_hosts)

```{python}
wc_hosts = pd.read_csv('./data/world_cup_hosts.csv')
```

```{python}
# Create a display table showing ten of the world's largest islands
gt_tbl = GT(wc_hosts)

# Show the output table
gt_tbl
```

## World cup games

The raw data comes from the [FIFA World Cup dataset](https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/abecklas/fifa-world-cup) on Kaggle. Specifically the `WorldCupMatches.csv` dataset.

```{python}
# Read data
wc_games = pd.read_csv('./data/WorldCupMatches.csv')
```

### Cleaning steps

#### Manual edits

- Some records had the dates recorded as June/July instead of Jun/Jul. These records were manually modified in the `.csv` file to ease further processing.
- In the 1982 World Cup the second group stage games were manually changed from `1` ... `4` to `A` ... `D`, so the `stage` labels are consistent across tournament years and need to be normalized before they can be used.

#### Deduplication

```{python}
# Drop extra rows where everything was null
wc_games = wc_games.dropna(how='all')

# Drop duplictaed rows
wc_games = wc_games.drop_duplicates()
```

#### Column names normalization

The raw column names are verbose and inconsistently cased, so they're mapped to short, `snake_case` names:

| Original name         | Normalized name  |
| ---------------------- | ---------------- |
| Year                    | year              |
| Datetime                | match_start       |
| Stage                   | stage             |
| Stadium                 | venue             |
| City                    | city              |
| Home Team Name          | home_team         |
| Away Team Name          | away_team         |
| Home Team Goals         | home_ft_goals     |
| Away Team Goals         | away_ft_goals     |
| Win conditions          | resolution_type   |
| Attendance              | attendance        |
| Half-time Home Goals    | home_ht_goals     |
| Half-time Away Goals    | away_ht_goals     |
| Referee                 | referee           |
| Assistant 1             | assistant_1       |
| Assistant 2             | assistant_2       |
| RoundID                 | round_id          |
| MatchID                 | match_id          |
| Home Team Initials      | home_initials     |
| Away Team Initials      | away_initials     |

```{python}
# Normalize column names
col_names_map = {'Year':'year',
             'Datetime':'match_start',
             'Stage':'stage',
             'Stadium':'venue',
             'City':'city',
             'Home Team Name':'home_team',
             'Away Team Name':'away_team',
             'Home Team Goals': 'home_ft_goals',
             'Away Team Goals': 'away_ft_goals',
             'Win conditions':'resolution_type',
             'Attendance':'attendance',
             'Half-time Home Goals':'home_ht_goals',
             'Half-time Away Goals':'away_ht_goals',
             'Referee':'referee',
             'Assistant 1':'assistant_1',
             'Assistant 2':'assistant_2',
             'RoundID':'round_id',
             'MatchID':'match_id',
             'Home Team Initials':'home_initials',
             'Away Team Initials':'away_initials'
             }
wc_games = wc_games.rename(columns=col_names_map)
```

#### Type normalization

##### Integers

```{python}
# Normalize int columns
# Set year as int
int_cols = ['year', 'home_ft_goals', 'away_ft_goals', 'attendance', 'home_ht_goals', 'away_ht_goals']
wc_games[int_cols] = wc_games[int_cols].astype('Int64')
```

##### Datetime

```{python}
# Normalize match_start
wc_games['match_start'] = wc_games['match_start'].str.strip()

# Set match_start to datetime
wc_games['parsed'] = pd.to_datetime(wc_games['match_start'], format='%d %b %Y - %H:%M', errors='coerce')

wc_games = wc_games.drop(columns='match_start').rename(columns={'parsed': 'match_start'})
```

##### Categorical

###### Stage

```{python}

def normalize_group_stage(row):

    # Normalize stage column
    stage_map_pre_1982 = {'Group 1':'Group stage',
                          'Group 2':'Group stage',
                          'Group 3':'Group stage',
                          'Group 4':'Group stage',
                          'Group A':'Second group stage',
                          'Group B':'Second group stage',
                          'Group 6':'Final round',
                          'Preliminary round':'Round of 16',
                          'First round':'Round of 16',
                          'Quarter-finals':'Quarter-finals',
                          'Semi-finals':'Semi-finals',
                          'Match for third place':'Third-place play-off',
                          'Final':'Final'}

    stage_map_1982 = {'Group 1':'Group stage',
                      'Group 2':'Group stage',
                      'Group 3':'Group stage',
                      'Group 4':'Group stage',
                      'Group 5':'Group stage',
                      'Group 6':'Group stage',
                      'Group A':'Second group stage',
                      'Group B':'Second group stage',
                      'Group C':'Second group stage',
                      'Group D':'Second group stage',
                      'Quarter-finals':'Quarter-finals',
                      'Semi-finals':'Semi-finals',
                      'Match for third place':'Third-place play-off',
                      'Final':'Final'}

    stage_map_1986_after = {'Group A':'Group stage',
                            'Group B':'Group stage',
                            'Group C':'Group stage',
                            'Group D':'Group stage',
                            'Group E':'Group stage',
                            'Group F':'Group stage',
                            'Group G':'Group stage',
                            'Group H':'Group stage',
                            'Round of 16':'Round of 16',
                            'Quarter-finals':'Quarter-finals',
                            'Semi-finals':'Semi-finals',
                            'Match for third place':'Third-place play-off',
                            'Third place':'Third-place play-off',
                            'Play-off for third place':'Third-place play-off',
                            'Final':'Final'}




    year = row['year']
    stage = row['stage']

    if year < 1982:
        mapping = stage_map_pre_1982
    elif year == 1982:
        mapping = stage_map_1982
    elif year >= 1986:
        mapping = stage_map_1986_after

    else:
        mapping = {}  # already normalized

    return mapping.get(stage, stage)  # fallback: leave unchanged

# Apply normalization of stages
wc_games['stage'] = wc_games.apply(normalize_group_stage, axis=1)
wc_games['stage'] = wc_games['stage'].astype("category")

```

###### Resolution type

```{python}

# Ended in regular time
mask = wc_games['resolution_type'] == ' '
wc_games.loc[mask, 'resolution_type'] = 'Regular time'

# Ended in extra time
mask = wc_games['resolution_type'].str.contains('extra time')
wc_games.loc[mask, 'resolution_type'] = 'Extra time'

# Ended in penalties
mask = wc_games['resolution_type'].str.contains('penalties')
wc_games.loc[mask, 'resolution_type'] = 'PK shootout'

# Ended in golden goal
mask = wc_games['resolution_type'].str.contains('Golden Goal')
wc_games.loc[mask, 'resolution_type'] = 'Golden goal'
```


# Team-level (long) dataset

For the hosting-premium analysis, each match needs to become two team-level observations rather than one row with a home and away side. `wc_games` is reshaped into `wc_games_long`, with one row per team per match (`match_id`, `year`, `team`, `goals_for`, `goals_against`), home row first:

```{python}
wc_games_reset = wc_games.reset_index(drop=True)

home = wc_games_reset[['match_id', 'year', 'home_team', 'home_ft_goals', 'away_ft_goals']].rename(
    columns={'home_team': 'team', 'home_ft_goals': 'goals_for', 'away_ft_goals': 'goals_against'}
)
away = wc_games_reset[['match_id', 'year', 'away_team', 'away_ft_goals', 'home_ft_goals']].rename(
    columns={'away_team': 'team', 'away_ft_goals': 'goals_for', 'home_ft_goals': 'goals_against'}
)
home['_match_order'] = away['_match_order'] = wc_games_reset.index

# Stable sort on the original match order keeps each match's home row before its away row
wc_games_long = (
    pd.concat([home, away], ignore_index=True)
    .sort_values('_match_order', kind='stable')
    .drop(columns='_match_order')
    .reset_index(drop=True)
)
```

# Output

The cleaned dataset is written out for downstream use (and eventual publication to Kaggle):

```{python}
wc_games.to_parquet('./data/WorldCupMatches.parquet')
```
